description: This file defines a logout route in a Remix-based frontend application. It includes a loader function that destroys the user session token and redirects to the login page, and a React component for the route that renders nothing.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Handles the logout process by clearing the user's session token and redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Logout
methods.description: React component for the logout route that renders nothing.
